title: First Notice of Loss
description: Interactive claim intake adapted from DocuBricks.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: first-notice-of-loss
  title: First Notice of Loss
  description: Claim intake form adapted from the DocuBricks insurance schema.
  version: 1.0.0
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: insurance_first_notice_of_loss_v1
    sourcePath: Schemas/insurance/first_notice_of_loss/fields.json
    sourceVersion: insurance_first_notice_of_loss_v1
spec:
  role: start
  pages:
    - id: loss-intake
      title: Loss intake
      description: Capture the minimum evidence needed to open and route a claim review.
      sections:
        - id: policy-and-reporter
          title: Policy and reporter
          fields:
            - id: policy-number
              name: policy_number
              label: Policy number
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
              ontologyPropertyRef: insurance_policy.policy_number
              accessibilityLabel: Insurance policy number
              errorMessage: Enter the policy number shown on the policy or notice.
            - id: insured-name
              name: insured_name
              label: Named insured
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              ontologyPropertyRef: insured_party.insured_name
            - id: reporting-party-name
              name: reporting_party_name
              label: Reporting party
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: loss-details
          title: Loss details
          fields:
            - id: reported-date
              name: reported_date
              label: Date reported
              dataType: date
              widget: date
              required: true
              ontologyPropertyRef: insurance_claim.reported_date
            - id: loss-date
              name: loss_date
              label: Date of loss
              dataType: date
              widget: date
              required: true
              ontologyPropertyRef: loss_event.loss_date
            - id: loss-location
              name: loss_location
              label: Loss location
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              ontologyPropertyRef: loss_event.loss_location
            - id: loss-description
              name: loss_description
              label: What happened?
              dataType: string
              widget: textarea
              required: true
              minLength: 20
              ontologyPropertyRef: loss_event.loss_description
              span: 2
            - id: estimated-loss-amount
              name: estimated_loss_amount
              label: Estimated loss amount
              dataType: number
              widget: number
              minimum: 0
              ontologyPropertyRef: loss_event.estimated_loss_amount
            - id: injury-indicator
              name: injury_indicator
              label: Were injuries reported?
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
              ontologyPropertyRef: loss_event.injury_indicator
        - id: review-materials
          title: Review materials
          description: Attach or summarize evidence required by the claim-review workflow.
          fields:
            - id: policy-wording
              name: policy_wording
              label: Policy wording
              dataType: string
              widget: file
              required: true
              ontologyPropertyRef: insurance_policy.policy_provisions_cited
              span: 2
            - id: prior-claims-history
              name: prior_claims_history
              label: Prior claims history
              dataType: string
              widget: textarea
              required: true
              ontologyPropertyRef: loss_event.loss_history_summary
              span: 2
  submissionSchema: {}
